title: Prompting With Verification
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting prompting with verification to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Write a prompt specific enough to produce checkable claims, and ask the model to flag uncertainty.
Separate the model's output into individual factual claims you can verify one at a time.
Confirm, correct, or remove each claim against an official source, and log the result.
Recognize a hallucination: a confident, specific claim with no source behind it.
